environment.description: Same Spring Boot application deployed on ECS Fargate but with a custom OCI runtime seccomp profile applied via the task definition's linuxParameters.seccompProfile field (type: Localhost, localhostProfile: /etc/seccomp/archive-svc.json). The profile operates in SCMP_ACT_ERRNO mode with a default action of SCMP_ACT_ALLOW but explicitly lists SCMP_ACT_ERRNO for syscalls: execve (nr 59), execveat (nr 322), ptrace (nr 101), socket (nr 41), connect (nr 42), bind (nr 49), clone3 (nr 435). Note: the JVM itself is launched before the seccomp profile is applied via the container entrypoint wrapper that forks and applies the filter to the child process only after JVM initialization completes. The profile also sets SCMP_ACT_LOG for write (nr 1) and openat (nr 257) when args[1] includes O_CREAT flag, but these are in log-only mode and do not block.

config.profile_application: post-JVM-init via entrypoint wrapper fork+seccomp_filter on child
config.network: no outbound (VPC endpoint only for ECR/CloudWatch)
